items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: It's Lou Jones on trumpet; Walter Phatz Morris on trombone and harmonica; Teddy Mc Cain on tenor sax.

ctx.x: No. I'll think of that later on too. Stancy. What's his name? Eddie Stancy. Organ.

You have one group listed here. This is after you made 'Topsy' and it looks like it was probably a working band. It's Lou Jones on trumpet; Walter Phatz Morris on trombone and harmonica; Teddy Mc Cain on tenor sax.
